coverage_policy.rationale: The bounded journey has four state score modes, each backed by a distinct PCM master: title vow, sect hub, combat pressure and result recovery. Event SFX are synthesized at runtime and are inventoried separately because they do not exist as persistent media files.

provenance_record.source: Project-authored procedural composition and synthesis implemented in scripts/audio/audio_director.gd; committed PCM masters live under assets/generated/audio/.
provenance_record.author: Vân Mộng Tu Tiên project production workflow
provenance_record.rights: Original project-generated audio; public commercial rights and project-wide license notices still require compliance sign-off before release.

coverage_requirements.rationale: Title and hub are long-lived navigation states and need a calm, non-fatiguing bed that survives repeated transitions without being required for comprehension.
The four-minute arena needs a clearly distinct higher-tempo score mode; sword, pickup, hit, pulse, breakthrough and boss feedback are supplied by the runtime procedural events listed below.
Victory and defeat share a quieter result bed while opposite melodic one-shots distinguish the outcome before the player chooses hub or retry.
Every raster command button calls the same short brush-tap cue; focus, text and authored button states remain the non-audio fallback.

events.trigger: AudioDirector._ready() and set_music_mode(&"title") when the front door is active.
CultivationFrontEnd routes the sect/meta shell to AudioDirector.set_music_mode(&"hub").
Events.game_started switches AudioDirector to combat mode.
Events.game_finished switches AudioDirector to result mode for either victory or defeat.

procedural_events.muted_fallback: Visible focus, pressed scale and caption state
Flying-sword sprite, trail and impact VFX
Qi beam, orb disappearance and XP meter change
Cinnabar hurt flash and numeric/health-meter change

procedural_events.trigger: Events.pulse_state_changed when a fresh cooldown begins
procedural_events.muted_fallback: Full radial boundary, burst and cooldown feedback

procedural_events.trigger: Game start, Events.upgrade_selected, and cultivation/realm banners
procedural_events.muted_fallback: Modal folios, ascension reveal, gold rings and banner text

procedural_events.trigger: Boss arrival banner containing GIÁNG THẾ or HIỆN THẾ
procedural_events.muted_fallback: Named boss plaque, health bar, announcement and threat ring
Ink burst, disappearing silhouette and qi drop
Victory title, gold/jade hierarchy and reward summary
Defeat title, cinnabar hierarchy and retained-reward summary
